messages:
marta: Quick sync — ran the end-to-end ingestion + query flow with Snowflake external functions -> Databricks UnityCatalog -> Qdrant vector index. Putting notes here so we can triage. link: https://redwood.internal/partners/e2e-1803

kevin: saw a few payload-size failures when the external function tried to send a 2.5MB JSON blob to our hosted inference endpoint. error: "413 Payload Too Large"

raj: that matches the Snowflake EF limit. For large batched docs we should either stream via staged files (S3 stage + presigned URL) or split into smaller batches client-side. staging avoids EF payload ceilings and is more retry-friendly.

olivia: FYI Databricks side had permission denials on Unity Catalog for the service principal. error was 403 on select + create external table. Need to add `USE CATALOG` and `USE SCHEMA` grants for the integration principal in the target workspace.

simon: on the Qdrant side, we noticed a lot of small writes causing index churn. Recommending grouping points into 5k batches and using compression=zip in the client. That cut indexing time by ~35% in our dev run.

elaine: quick product/marketplace question — do we list this as a "direct connector" in the marketplace or as a "partner solution" that requires our README + quickstart? Also need to confirm Security Review doc for Private deployments.

partner-bot: CI run #482 finished: e2e-integration-tests (snowflake + databricks + qdrant) -> 6 failures, 14 passed. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/482

marta: Action items I propose:
• kevin: add staged upload flow PoC and a fallback that splits payloads <1MB (owner: kevin)
• raj: write short dev note on recommended Snowflake patterns (external stage vs EF) + sample SQL (owner: raj)
• olivia: confirm Unity Catalog grants matrix and add to onboarding checklist (owner: olivia)
• simon: update qdrant client defaults in our connector (batch size + compression) (owner: simon)
• elaine: start marketplace listing checklist + security review kickoff with legal (owner: elaine)
Please ack or reassign. :clipboard: :spiral_calendar:

kevin: ack, will push a small PoC branch today.

raj: small SQL snippet for EF pattern (from PoC):
```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION call_inference(url STRING, payload STRING)
RETURNS VARIANT LANGUAGE JAVASCRIPT AS $$
  // fetch using staged presigned URL flow
  // simplified for example
  var response = EXTERNAL_FETCH(url, { method: 'POST', body: payload });
  return response;
$$;
```

olivia: added a note + grant checklist to the onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/partner-onboarding#unity-catalog-grants — specifically callout to `CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE` and `MANAGE GRANTS` for the service principal.

simion: (typo) oops meant simon — also adding that we should expose an env var for index_shard_size in the connector so customers can tweak for their dataset distribution.

elaine: for marketplace listing: we usually want a published connector entry + step-by-step quickstart. I'll open the PR template and tag legal for the security review. Proposed deadline: next Tue for initial draft, demo the following week.

marta: sounds good. One more question — fallback policy: if Snowflake EF is rate-limited or payload fails, do we prefer retry/stage or route to hosted Redwood API? simon: your thought?

simon: prefer staging + retry first (cheaper, avoids cross-service routing). but we should allow an explicit route to hosted Redwood API as canary/costly fallback for enterprise customers that want single-call UX. Document both in the connector docs.

kevin: added a tiny test harness to repo and linked it in the PoC branch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-connectors/pull/128 — includes staged-upload example and splitter util.

raj: I'll draft the "recommended pattern" short doc and include the SQL + presign workflow. Will ping partnerships channel when ready.

elaine: scheduling a 30m sync with Snowflake PM and Databricks partner lead next Thu 10am PT. Calendar invite sent to involved folks.

marta: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll close the loop after the sync and update the partner roadmap. :white_check_mark:

kevin: thanks — filing a follow-up issue for telemetry to capture EF payload size and failure reasons.

olivia: quick FYI — when we demo to the customer pilot, remember Unity Catalog is workspace-scoped; we need to ensure they have workspace-level grants before the demo run.

marta: noted. closing thread for now, will reopen if anything blocks before Thu.
